name: ThirdPersonCameraData
description: Configuration and runtime state for a local third-person top-down camera.

variables.name: follow_lerp_speed
variables.description: How quickly the camera rig follows the player target.

variables.name: gamepad_yaw_speed
variables.description: Yaw rotation speed in degrees per second for gamepad right stick input.

variables.name: gamepad_pitch_speed
variables.description: Pitch rotation speed in degrees per second for gamepad right stick input.

variables.name: mouse_yaw_sensitivity
variables.description: Yaw rotation in degrees per mouse delta unit while the rotate mouse button is held.

variables.name: mouse_pitch_sensitivity
variables.description: Pitch rotation in degrees per mouse delta unit while the rotate mouse button is held.

variables.name: pitch_min
variables.description: Minimum camera local X pitch angle in degrees.

variables.name: pitch_max
variables.description: Maximum camera local X pitch angle in degrees.

variables.name: current_pitch
variables.description: Current camera local X pitch angle in degrees.

variables.name: look_dead_zone
variables.description: Minimum look vector length before camera rotation starts.

variables.name: current_gamepad_look
variables.description: Latest accepted gamepad look input for debugging.

variables.name: current_mouse_look
variables.description: Latest accepted mouse look input for debugging.

variables.name: is_rotating
variables.description: True during frames where camera rotation input is accepted.
